shellCommands.command: /bin/bash -lc "printf '%s\\n' '--- files ---'; rg --files -g '"'!*node_modules*'"' | sed -n '1,120p'; printf '%s\\n' '--- package ---'; cat package.json; printf '%s\\n' '--- next docs candidates ---'; rg --files node_modules/next/dist/docs | rg '/(proxy|middleware|request|instrumentation)' | sed -n '1,80p'"

/bin/bash -lc "printf '%s\\n' '--- AGENTS ---'; cat AGENTS.md; printf '%s\\n' '--- proxy guide ---'; sed -n '1,260p' node_modules/next/dist/docs/01-app/03-api-reference/03-file-conventions/proxy.md; printf '%s\\n' '--- middleware deprecation ---'; sed -n '1,180p' node_modules/next/dist/docs/01-app/03-api-reference/03-file-conventions/middleware.md; printf '%s\\n' '--- config ---'; cat next.config.ts; printf '%s\\n' '--- tsconfig ---'; cat tsconfig.json"

/bin/bash -lc "apply_patch <<'PATCH'
*** Begin Patch
*** Add File: proxy.ts
+import type { NextRequest } from 'next/server'
+import { NextResponse } from 'next/server'
+
+export function proxy(request: NextRequest) {
+  console.log("'`${request.method} ${request.nextUrl.pathname}${request.nextUrl.search}`)
+
+  return NextResponse.next()
+}
*** End Patch
PATCH
npm run build'

/bin/bash -lc "apply_patch <<'PATCH'
*** Begin Patch
*** Update File: tsconfig.json
@@
-    \"lib\": [
-      \"dom\",
-      \"dom.iterable\",
-      \"esnext\"
-    ],
+    \"lib\": [\"dom\", \"dom.iterable\", \"esnext\"],
@@
-    \"paths\": {
-      \"@/*\": [
-        \"./*\"
-      ]
-    }
+    \"paths\": {
+      \"@/*\": [\"./*\"]
+    }
   },
-  \"include\": [
-    \"next-env.d.ts\",
-    \"**/*.ts\",
-    \"**/*.tsx\",
-    \".next/types/**/*.ts\",
-    \".next/dev/types/**/*.ts\"
-  ],
-  \"exclude\": [
-    \"node_modules\"
-  ]
+  \"include\": [\"next-env.d.ts\", \"**/*.ts\", \"**/*.tsx\", \".next/types/**/*.ts\"],
+  \"exclude\": [\"node_modules\"]
 }
*** End Patch
PATCH
rm -rf .next next-env.d.ts
git diff --check
git diff -- proxy.ts tsconfig.json
git status --short"
